title: excel-inflow-release-journal-record/1.0
description: P8.6a — one record of the append-only release journal. Every release-affecting event (compile, attest, tag, retain, promote, rollback, supersede) is one record. Records are stored one canonical JSON object per line in a .jsonl journal and are hash-chained in the same discipline as the user-flow stage receipts (scripts/lib/flow_runtime.mjs createStageReceipt): record_hash is the canonical digest of the record body with record_hash removed, and previous_record_hash is the preceding record's record_hash (null only at sequence 0). This file constrains SHAPE only; sequence contiguity, chain linkage, timestamp monotonicity, retention-precedes-rollback, no-re-promotion-after-rollback and every vocabulary membership are enforced by scripts/lib/release_journal.mjs. This is a RELEASE journal — it is not, and must never be conflated with, the per-run resumability receipts of scripts/lib/release_checkpoint_store.mjs.

sequence.description: Zero-based position in the journal. Contiguous by construction; a gap is a deletion and is refused.

event_type.description: compile: a package was written from a frozen source. attest: an external release-package attestation was issued. tag: an immutable release tag was created. retain: a package was retained as the previous-known-good rollback target. promote: a package became the production route. rollback: a promoted package was withdrawn in favour of a retained target. supersede: a retained target was replaced by a newer one.

recorded_at.description: UTC instant. Non-decreasing across the journal; a backdated record is refused.

kind.description: A rollback event must be authorised by a human; automation may record, never authorise.

policy_sha256.description: Canonical digest of assets/release-rollback-policy-v1.json in force when the record was sealed.

previous_record_hash.description: The preceding record's record_hash; null only at sequence 0.

record_hash.description: Canonical digest of this record with record_hash removed.

release_identity.description: The package identity this event is ABOUT, in the same terms as product-identity/2.0 (scripts/lib/identity_vocabulary.mjs). On a rollback record this is the WITHDRAWN package; the target is in rollback.to.

package_mode.description: Must be a PACKAGE_MODES member; membership enforced in code.

deployment_status.description: Must be a DEPLOYMENT_STATUSES member; membership enforced in code. Exactly the rollback records carry "rollback".

trigger_id.description: Must be a declared trigger in the rollback policy's trigger_conditions clause.

authorisation_reference.description: Where the human authorisation is recorded (issue card, checkpoint, approval receipt).

target_attestation_status.description: A rollback target must be attestable: verifyReleasePackageAttestation over the retained package must PASS and bind the target closure. Anything else is refused before the record is written.

disposition.description: Must be an allowed disposition in the policy's in_flight_run_package_pinning clause. A run's package identity is pinned at run start and is never re-pointed by a rollback.

terminal_reason_code.description: Null for a pinned continuation; for a stopped run, the ALREADY REGISTERED reason code the policy names. The journal never mints reason codes.

preserved_evidence.description: Paths of the evidence preserved by this rollback. Every class the policy marks never_delete must be represented.
